scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
A long time ago,
when Payon was still
developing, many of the
villagers lived in poverty.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text: Many families had to struggle to survive, and often could not even afford to properly bury their dead. Some people threw their dead into the cave near the village.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
So in that cave, it is said that there are many walking Zombies,
the dead who cannot rest in peace and are unable to pass on to the next world.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
The Zombies, upon sensing the warmth of a human, begin to assault them, but that doesn't mean these Undead hold a grudge against
the living.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text: Their rotten bodies can't leave the cold, dark and damp cave, so it's instinctual for them to attack warmth which would speed up the decomposition of their bodies.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
The Zombies in the Payon Cave
may be spooky, but their story
is also kind of tragic.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
From your attire,
I can see that you
are a stranger here.
Welcome to Payon.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: You must be a well-experienced fighter, otherwise you'd never be able to arrive here after passing the steep, mountainous areas and dangerous creatures surrounding this city.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: I'm no expert at fighting, but someone once told me that sheer strength alone won't be able to win some battles.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: Sometimes, you may encounter creatures protected by a hard-shell that don't be damaged by physical attacks. Only psychic power, like Magic, can easily defeat such creatures.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: Of course, not everyone can study magic. The point is that you should keep different kinds of friends and comrades close to you, as you can't possibly handle every situation by yourself.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: I remember the story my dearly departed grandfather has told me.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
It's about this Amulet that possesses an Evil Power.
With it, you could awaken
the Dead from the Grave.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Well, I'm not sure if it's true or not. But, I wonder, what would happen if I used it to summon
my grandfather from the other realm....

^3299CCNever think
of such a thing...
My son.^000000

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
EEEEEEK-!
What was that?!
G-grandpa...?

scripts.speaker: Guardsman
scripts.text: This is the Central Palace of Payon. This place is open to the public, but in accordance with our laws, you must behave in an orderly fashion once inside.

scripts.speaker: Guardsman
scripts.text:
In the interest of protecting the peace, we will disarm your equipment once you enter.
Your cooperation is
much appreciated.

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text:
Welcome to Payon.
You must have had
a hard time getting
through the Payon Forest.
How was your trip?

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: We've been receiving less tourists because of the increasing numbers of monsters outside, so it's quieter nowadays.

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: To be honest, things are getting tough because of all those monsters. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: Whoa~! I just noticed those arms of yours look pretty solid. You look pretty strong, guy. Just how many monsters have you killed?!

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: Oooh! I didn't notice before, but you look pretty strong beneath all of that feminine charm.

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: Hey, I know of a good place for you to hunt. It just so happens that there's a cave in the middle of Payon.

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: If you're interested, just head North, pass the forest, and go towards the Northwest. You'll know you've arrived when you're in the place filled with the smell of stinky monsters.
It sounds dangerous!
I better prepare myself...!
That's a nice dress you're wearing~

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text:
Oh come on, don't be a coward.
It's just a simple cave filled with normal monsters. It's quite safe. We've even established an Archer Village near that cave to prevent misfortune incidents. Hohoohoho~

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text: Oh don't worry about any preparations. There's a Tool Dealer right in front of the cave, so you can purchase anything you need from my husband, er, that guy~

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text:
Oh hohohoho!
So you've noticed?
I hear this is the
latest trend in Prontera
these days.

scripts.speaker: Woman
scripts.text:
Most of the women in this town don't know anything about fashion! My husband bought this for me as
a present. He makes quite a lot of money, you know. Hohohoho~

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
Oh boy~
There she goes again.
Without a doubt, that
woman is the town gossip.

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
Please don't judge the rest
of the people living in Payon by her behavior. She's the only loudmouth. I guess she's just too excited about what the fortune teller told her.

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
Ooh...!
You've got
such broad shoulders!
Will you go out with me?
I'll treat you to
a nice dinner~

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
My, you're a pretty girl!
I'm sure you're always busy
beating the boys away with a stick...
Or a well timed insult joke.
Fortune Teller...?
Well, see you later~

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
Oh yes...
There's an extraordinary fortune teller in the Central Palace of Payon. The more Zeny you pay her, the better fortune you'll get!

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
She told me
I would meet
a nice guy this month.
Hohohoho~

scripts.speaker: Jim's Mother
scripts.text:
Mmmm...?
You don't have
any time to stay
and chit-chat with me?

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Hey...
H-Hey...!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
I wonder why those
stupid Archers even
bother trying to aim!
You're all weak!
Weeeeak!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Bwahahahaha!
Buy me a drink?!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
An Archer!
Oh man, you guys!
You guys are the best!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Bwahahahaha!
Buy me a drink?!
Alright, but only one drink.
No thanks, pal.
Oh my God! Hell no!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Thanks...!
..Brother!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Most people don't even wanna
buy me drinks! Maybe cuz I used to fool around too much with the ladies back in my day!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text: Though, the women I used to play with are grannies now! Hahahaha! One of them still primps herself with makeup and stuff! Can you believe that?!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
I'm like...
Come on...!
Some faces are
beyond fixing!
Oh? I made a funny!
Bwahahahahahah!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
^666666*Gulp~ Gulp~*^000000
Man, this is great!
You the maaaaaaan~!
Muhahahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Bah!
Kids nowadays!
Now respect for
their elders! Fine!
I'm not gonna beg you!

scripts.speaker: Drunkard
scripts.text:
Fine...!
Fine by me!

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
Nice to meet you.
I am called Vuicokk.
I am a scholar in the Monster Research organization of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any questions about monsters?
Any news?
Undead Monsters?
Monster Research Organization?

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: Payon is located deep inside the forest where it can easily be attacked by hordes of monsters. Monsters also come from the dangerous cave located near town.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: Since Undead monsters roam the Payon Cave, it has attracted the attention of the monster academic world. My job here is to analyze their characteristics.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: What is most remarkable of the Undead monsters in Payon is their origin Most of them used to be citizens of Payon!

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
However, these souls are
unable to rest in peace and still wander about as Undead bound
to this world.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: These monsters cannot be classified with other monsters that have mutated from living creatures, so our wise and benevolent ruler, King Tristram III, has taken a great interest in Payon's Undead.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
After all, some of these
Undead used to belong to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
As his subjects,
King Tristram III
feels some responsibility
to release their souls.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
His Majesty has been supporting
us in our search to discover how to eliminate all of the Undead in this world. We will try to accomplish this goal as soon as we
possibly can.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
For the safety of our people,
for the sake of their bereaved families, and in accordance with King Tristram III's order, we must succeed!

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
As you may well know,
monsters have been endlessly spawning in this world, and the threat of their attacks is grows greater every day.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
In response to this,
 the Monster Research
Organization has been formed.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: Talented people around the world have joined forces in an effort to deduce the origin of monsters, and a way to eliminate them once and for all.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text:
Of course, it's not
as easy as you would may believe. Many have sacrificed their lives in the pursuit of this knowledge.

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: In our missions, the number of victims of monster attacks have been countless. Still, nothing can stop us. If our suffering can save humanity, so be it!

scripts.speaker: Monster Scholar Vuicokk
scripts.text: ^666666*Ahem*^000000 My apologies, I get too excited sometimes. But if you happen to meet other scholars such as myself, please treat them well. Our jobs are very difficult!

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: This place is always bustling with busy people. Little Novices come and go to become Archers, and everyone else is buying arrows while I have to stay here in this small shop.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
And I'm sick and tired of making this noodle soup. I have to shower all the time so I can get rid of the smell. And it's not so easy
to get rid of.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
I feel so...
Bored.
And lonely...

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: Where I can find the right person, a hot and Sexy hunk who can take me away from here? Um, hey mister, are you listening?

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
Where I can find the right person, a cute, yet hard-bodied hunk who can take me away from here?
Um, hey lady, are
you listening?

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: The old fortune teller told me that I'd have great luck in the near future! But what's wrong with me? I'm just living day to day. Maybe I'm just dumb and wishy-washy.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
I'm so sorry,
I've said too much.
Now I'm just acting stupid.
I'm sorry you had to listen
to all that.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
So...
How may I help you?
Have you ever heard of Zombies?
Fortune Teller...?
I needs some booze.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
Of course I've
heard of Zombies!
This is Payon, after all.
Zombies are the walking
Undead, and you can easily
find them around here.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: I hear that they fear holiness, so Archers prefer to use arrow made out of silver, a holy metal, against them.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: Legend says that the chief of this town used silver arrows against Zombies that used to be his brethren in order to release their souls so that they may rest in peace.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
We believe that exorcising
Zombies in this way will lead them peacefully to the afterlife. Their souls no longer need to anguish.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: You might not share our beliefs, but my grandfather was one of the Undead. I appreciate that the chief was able to free him from being bound to the world of the living.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
Oh! Our fortune teller is a really extraordinary person. Well, she doesn't hang around here as
much as she used to do.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text: She used to stay here to tell fortunes for our patrons, but ever since the chief recognized her talents, she now stays in the Central Palace. So you'd better go there if you want to see her.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
You...
needs some
booze, eh?
Don't we all?

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
But I'm so sorry, we sold out.
And we can't afford to prepare alcohol anymore because of the hostile creatures out there. But please come again later. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
Have a nice
day, dearie.

scripts.speaker: Pub Lady
scripts.text:
^666666*Sob*^000000
When will I be romanced
by my perfectly formed,
yet well read man?

scripts.speaker: Chief Guardsman
scripts.text:
What brings
you here?

scripts.speaker: Chief Guardsman
scripts.text:
I can see that you are not one of the Payon locals. I would just like to remind you to conduct yourself in an orderly manner. Remember,
you are a guest here.

scripts.speaker: Chief Guardsman
scripts.text: In the interest of protecting the public peace, I will disarm your equipment. Thank you for your cooperation.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
I'm kind of worried
about one of my pals.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text: Even though he's an expert at archery, no one likes his motor mouth. Even our chief is getting fed up with him!
Your friend?
Payon has a chief?
Motor... Mouth?

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
Ah, right. This buddy of mine is the number one archer in Payon.
He teaches newbie Archers around the Archer Village. It might be a good idea to talk to him at least once.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text: Our chief lives in the Central Palace. I guess you can say that he's the spiritual guide of Payon.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text: He used to menace the monsters in Payon Forest, carrying his Gakkung. I remember watching him fight when I was just a little kid.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
But now he
seems old and weak.
Still, his eyes are as sharp as they used to be during his days
of battle, where he'd never miss
a target.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
I admire our chief
from the bottom
of my heart.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
You don't know
what a motormouth is...?

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
Motormouth
Noun. Some fool who chatters
way too much about stuff that doesn't really matter and doesn't know when to stop.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
But yeah, my pal is not only
a legend at archery, he's also well known for how long he's let that mouth of his run.

scripts.speaker: Archer Zakk
scripts.text:
Anyway, my pal Wolt doesn't have
a place of his own, so he stays at the Inn. Why don't you go and meet him? He's actually an okay guy if you can stand all the chatter.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Archers should
practice as much
as they can. Otherwise,
they'll never become experts.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Oh, hey there!
I'm Wolt the Archer,
but, erm, you can
just call me 'Wolt.'

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
I know this is a bit of an unexpected question, but do
you tend to spend a lot of your
time in idleness?
Oh, hell no.
Yeah. I guess...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Ooh. That's good. In fact, that's great! If only all of us Archers had that kind of attitude. If you have time to just sit around, then you have the time to go out and practice!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Yeah...
As Archers, we kind of look
down on people who slack off
on the training.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
If you don't work hard, then you'll end up being a horrible Archer. No one can depend on your aim!
I mean, nobody!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Did you ask how we go about
our training? Well, the Archers of Payon don't have much time to just play around with their Bows.
I guess we go out and
engage in actual fighting.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
So we just carry out Bows wherever we go, and spend all day looking for monsters to kill. Oh, and after we find some monsters, we
kill them of course. That almost goes without saying.
I guess you'd need a good Bow.
You call that 'practice?!'

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
That's right!
An Archer depends
on the strength
of his Bow!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Bows constructed in Payon
are the greatest on this continent! They are light and stout, made out of high quality tree Trunks from Payon Forest!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
The quality of the wood often determines the quality of the Bow. My lil' sweety was made out of a walnut tree, and is strong enough to bear thousands of pounds
of force.

scripts.speaker: Arche Wolt
scripts.text: Oh, oh! And my Bow's stylish as well. It comes in a sophisticated ebony color, and I just look so cool and heroic while I'm killing monsters~!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Oh, and the trees in Payon Forest are famous for the quality of their wood. But then, more and more of them have been turning into monsters. Is this the work of evil forces?!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: It's a pity because the tree monsters used to be beautiful, majestic trees. But then it's okay if we kill them, so that we can make Bows out of their wood.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: And then we use these Bows to kill even more tree monsters... And then make more wood! Mwahahahaha! It's an endless cycle!
^666666*Ahem!*^000000 Speaking of endless...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Yeah...
You're right.
Monsters are everywhere,
can you believe it?

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Do you understand
why the Archer Village
was built where it is?

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: To the West, near Archer Village, you'll see Payon Cave. Inside the cave, an enormous amount of monster endlessly spawn without showing any sign of slowing down.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: We Archers are here to protect our territory against them, as ordered by our honorable chief!
Cave, you say?
Chief...?
Oh man, I hate this town!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
If you head North
of town, you'll find
Payon Cave.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Once inside, you'll encounter all sorts lots of ugly monsters. Like those nasty looking Bats, and
those Zombies...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: If we let them out of that place, they'd run all over Payon! So, we gotta get in there and clean that place up of monsters.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: But since these monsters endlessly respawn, sometimes I feel like we're wasting our time and energy for nothing...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Whoa...
Alright, I think yet my mouth run
a marathon again. I better let you go. There's lots of training to do, and plenty of monsters to kill!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Heh heh heh~
I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Keep it closed. Shutting up now. Quiet as a mouse. Seeya later~!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
And you don't?
What better practice
than the real, honest
to goodness thing?

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Though, you may have a point
there. I mean, you should be able to practice without having to suffer serious consequences.
You know, like death.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
But we've gotta make do
with what we've got!
An Archer's life is
endless training!
Endless practice!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Hm...?
Are you tired of me repeating the same thing over and over again?
Oh, just bear with me. Think of it as practicing your patience~

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Eh...
I guess it's important
to set aside time to rest.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: But it's also a good idea to set aside time for practicing and training, and practicing and training!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: And it's a very bad idea to rest when you should be alert, or well, when you're supposed to be doing something else.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
That reminds me of the time
I set fire to my house during the holidays. It was an accident, of course, but boy, were my folks angry!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Hahahaha~
It all started when I decided to take a bath. Here, in Payon, we use the old style baths, so we need to make a fire to heat the water. Cold baths are just so uncomfortable.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: But nice, warm baths are veeeery comfortable. That was probably the best bath I had in my life! It was so comfortable, I fell asleep.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
But while I was sleeping,
I guess I didn't notice the fire reach the floor, walls and ceiling! Luckily, I was in a tub full of water, so I was okay.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: I would've gotten help if it weren't for the fact that the fire had burned my clothes while I was napping. So, of course, I couldn't just run around town in the nude.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
So...
I just sat in the water for about an hour, completely naked, and yelling 'Help me,' until someone could hear me.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: But, it turned out that no one could hear me. Luckily, our roof caved in and totally demolished our walls so that my screams could finally reach passerby. And it was in that way that I survived.
Um, what's the point of that story?
I guess I better not get lazy then.
Blah blah blah. See ya.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Oh...
Umm...
You mean, like,
the moral of the story?

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Resting during the right times is perfectly fine. Just don't go and take a break when you shouldn't. That kind of behavior would make anyone in our town angry!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Our chief is especially annoyed by that kind of irresponsible attitude. I guess, around here, only the town drunkard subscribes to that kind of policy.
Chief?
Town Drunkard?
Man, you talk too much!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text: A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Heh heh heh~
I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Complete silence. I'm not even opening my mouth. Starting right about... Now!
Seeya later~!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
You know...
The guy in the pub.
Loud, and obnoxious
and annoying to liste--

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
Anyway, when I have
some spare cash, I try
to buy him a drink.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Still...
It's not a good
idea to drink so much.
Or as much as he does...

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Oh good~!
I guess you got
the point of my story!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
We, as Archers, put a lot of importance on training and practice, so we kind of look
down on people who aren't
diligent at all.

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
Still...
I have to admit that, at heart,
I'm a pretty lazy guy. I guess it's pretty amazing that someone like
me can even be an Archer!

scripts.speaker: Archer Wolt
scripts.text:
In any case,
whatever you do
in life, do it
with passion!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Hey...
Hey...!
Show your respect
to our chief!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Hey...
Hey...!
Show your respect
to our chief!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Heeeey!
I said...

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
It's fine, it's fine.
It's been a long time
since I've spoken to
such young people.
Please tell me about Payon.
Where are the guards from?
Please tell me about the cave.
What does an Archer do?
What does a Hunter do?

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Payon is the city of highlanders. As long as our history can relate, our city has been self-sufficient.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Although our ancestors did not enjoy the benefits of cultural exchange with the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom as we do today, they knew how to make a living without
any help.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Payon has developed its own cultures and ways. We've invented our own means to protect ourselves against the elements, and Payon men and women train as Archers and Hunters to defend themselves.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
I've heard of weak, cowardly
young people who fear the fields or dungeons filled with monsters. But to us, battle is a way of life.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: That is why his Majesty, King Tristram III wishes for us to train young people how to effectively fight against evil creatures.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Even since I was young,
Prontera has sent civil
servants and envoys to Payon.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Royal troops, Kafra Ladies, Guards... At first, there was conflict brought about by differences in our customs
and cultures.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
However, as time passed,
we've been able to resolve such petty differences. I cannot deny that they've helped us speedily develop our trade with foreign nations.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Now, people who used to be outsiders are now bonifide Payon citizens. When I was young, I would never imagined such a thing possible. Hahahaha~!

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: It pleases me to see and meet with them. Even though have come from other places, they have a love for Payon that is as sincere as my own.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Ah...
I used to go to the cave
to the North sometimes. But it
is harder now than it was then.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Evil creatures that I've never seen before endlessly respawn in that place. The monsters in Payon Cave today are different than the ones we used to fight with.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Have you ever happened to see
the Zombies...? Some of them are warriors who entered the cave to protect this village, but never came back.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Although they are a threat, some of those Undead are also victims of that cave. I'm too old to endure that kind of pain...

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: I must do anything I can to stop the Undead, and release their souls from eternal anguish.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Ah, it is fortunate that archery is a specialty here in Payon. Because of the surrounding forest, we have an abundant supply of wood to create Bows.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: The forest also is a good training place for Archers to learn how to use their environment to impede the advance of their enemies while attacking from a safe distance.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: The forest can also be convenient in unexpected ways. When I was young, I ran out of arrows while fighting against monsters in the woods, but arrows dropped by other monsters saved my life! Mwahah!

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: As foreign cultures were introduced to Payon, changes have been brought about to our battle style.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Technology, especially that of explosives, enabled new methods
of battle. We were no longer limited to the use of just bows and arrows.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
Trapping skills, which make
hunting monsters much easier, were developed enable here in Payon. Experts in the new skills were dubbed 'Hunters' by our previous Chief.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text: Although highly effective, trapping is a really dangerous skill if not used properly. That's why we do not approve of the inexperienced becoming Hunters.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
However, we welcome people
who have proven to be capable to take the challenge of the Hunter class.

scripts.speaker: Chief
scripts.text:
So tired...
I'd better rest.
Please, take care
of yourself.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Hey...!
You're not
allowed here!
Go back outside!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
I'm sorry,
but you're
not allowed here.
Please leave.

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Payon!
Such a wonderful
place! Superb Bows
and skillful Archers!

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Hey you~!
Have you heard
of famous Payon?
Yeah, of course~!
Pay...on?

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Oh! You the man!
You know the Archers of Payon!
We never miss our target! Even from a distance, the hearts of our foes are unsafe!
So, you like this place, huh?
Hahahaha~

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Yes! I love this place!
I love this city so much,
I've even been doing research on it! If there's anything you wanna know about Payon, please ask me!
The people wear unique clothing here.
What's the building in the middle of town?
Who's that guy drinking over there?
Talk to you later.

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Yes, I agree.
You must know this place used to be isolated because of the thick forests and the mountainous area.

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text: Because of that, the Payon developed a culture of its own, which is quite different than that of the rest of Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text: This garment is traditional Payon clothing! Why don't you try wearing one? It's very comfortable~

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text: You mean the Central Palace? Strangers aren't allowed to enter that place. People say the royal family and their friends from outside gather there.

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text: I'd like to go there sometime, and see what it's like on the inside!

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Oh! That guy's notorious!
Whatever you do, don't treat
him to any drinks!
You'll regret it!

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Okay!
See ya!
Catch you later!

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
What a shame...
How have you not
heard of the Payon Archers?

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Well, when you 
learn more about us,
let's talk again and I can tell you why the Payon Archers are
so great!

scripts.speaker: Archer Joe
scripts.text:
Why are
you so quiet?
You're not shy, are you?
Come on, there's no reason
to be bashful around me~
